title: Retail Salespersons
description: Sell merchandise, such as furniture, motor vehicles, appliances, or apparel to consumers.

tasks.text: Greet customers and ascertain what each customer wants or needs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer needs discovery needs live interaction

dwas.name: Gather customer or product information to determine customer needs.
Greet customers, patrons, or visitors.

tasks.text: Recommend, select, and help locate or obtain merchandise based on customer needs and desires.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Product recommendations need customer context and persuasion

dwas.name: Recommend products or services to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Compute sales prices, total purchases, and receive and process cash or credit payment.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost calculation from structured inputs

dwas.name: Calculate costs of goods or services.
Process sales or other transactions.

tasks.text: Prepare merchandise for purchase or rental.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Setting up displays requires hands-on placement

dwas.name: Set up merchandise displays.

tasks.text: Answer questions regarding the store and its merchandise.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product questions answered from knowledge base

dwas.name: Answer customer questions about goods or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Maintain knowledge of current sales and promotions, policies regarding payment and exchanges, and security practices.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI reviews and summarizes laws; human confirms

dwas.name: Review laws or regulations to maintain professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Demonstrate use or operation of merchandise.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live product demonstration requires physical presence

dwas.name: Demonstrate products to consumers.

tasks.text: Describe merchandise and explain use, operation, and care of merchandise to customers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product-use advice is largely informational with review

dwas.name: Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

dwas.name: Advise customers on the use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Ticket, arrange, and display merchandise to promote sales.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Setting up displays requires hands-on placement

dwas.name: Set up merchandise displays.

tasks.text: Inventory stock and requisition new stock.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Merchandise purchasing aided; human owns buying decisions

dwas.name: Purchase stocks of merchandise or supplies.
Monitor inventories of products or materials.

tasks.text: Exchange merchandise for customers and accept returns.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transaction processing software-driven; human handles exceptions

dwas.name: Process sales or other transactions.

tasks.text: Watch for and recognize security risks and thefts and know how to prevent or handle these situations.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Security monitoring of work areas needs physical presence

dwas.name: Monitor work areas to provide security.

tasks.text: Place special orders or call other stores to find desired items.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft contracts; legal terms human-owned

dwas.name: Prepare sales or other contracts.

tasks.text: Clean shelves, counters, and tables.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

dwas.name: Clean work areas.

tasks.text: Maintain records related to sales.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured sales records via tools

dwas.name: Maintain records of sales or other business transactions.

tasks.text: Open and close cash registers, performing tasks such as counting money, separating charge slips, coupons, and vouchers, balancing cash drawers, and making deposits.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Reconciling transaction records is rule-based matching

dwas.name: Reconcile records of sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Prepare sales slips or sales contracts.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft contracts; legal terms human-owned

dwas.name: Prepare sales or other contracts.

tasks.text: Estimate and quote trade-in allowances.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Estimates costs/terms; human negotiates and commits

dwas.name: Estimate costs or terms of sales.

tasks.text: Bag or package purchases and wrap gifts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on packaging of products

dwas.name: Package materials or products.

tasks.text: Help customers try on or fit merchandise.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Persuasive product advice; human trust matters

dwas.name: Assist customers with product selection.

tasks.text: Sell or arrange for delivery, insurance, financing, or service contracts for merchandise.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can arrange deliveries; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Sell products or services.
Arrange delivery of goods or services.

tasks.text: Estimate quantity and cost of merchandise required, such as paint or floor covering.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Estimates costs/terms; human negotiates and commits

dwas.name: Estimate costs or terms of sales.

tasks.text: Rent merchandise to customers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Arranging reservations and services via tools

dwas.name: Arrange services or reservations for patrons.

tasks.text: Estimate cost of repair or alteration of merchandise.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Estimates costs/terms; human negotiates and commits

dwas.name: Estimate costs or terms of sales.
